description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Complete Transfer Case Shifter Repair Kit which is the only kit that repairs all aspects of the Transfer Case shifting mechanism.
Repairs both the Transfer Case Shift Lever and Shifting Rods.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
To Repair Shifting Rods / Shafts
Qty 1 – E-Ring
Qty 1 – Spring Pin, Front Drive Fork
Qty 1 – Spring Pin, Reduction Fork
Qty 3 – Ball, Shaft (Reduction & Front Drive)
Qty 1 – Ball, Shaft (Front Drive)
Qty 2 – Spring, Shaft (Reduction & Front Drive)
Qty 1 – Screw, (Spring Cap)
To Repair Shift Lever
Qty 1 – Sheet Shifter
Qty 1 – Spring, Shift Lever
Qty 1 – Boot #2, Shift Lever
Qty 1 – Clamp, Boot #2
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
